P052.title: Development of a model for stochastic analysis of vehicle–track interaction considering spatial variability of track parameters
P052.label: Liu等（2023）

complete_examples.text: Aiming at the clarification of the spatial variability and correlation of track parameters on the influence of vehicle-track dynamic performance, a general scheme based on Karhunen–Loève Expansion and cyclic calculation method is developed to realize a multi- dimensional random field that holds an arbitrary marginal distribution function and correlation structure, and to consider the inhomogeneity of system parameters along the longitudinal direction efficiently.

In this paper, a practical method for modeling the vehicle-track system with consideration of the spatial variability, and coherence of system parameters is proposed, where the parameter distributions in the spatial domain are regarded as a multi-dimensional random field in Section 2.
